meta.title: 为什么你总觉得自己不好看的原因找到了！
meta.title_en: Why You Think You Look Bad: The Real Reasons

scenes.title_en: Press Your Lips: Nasolabial Fold Test
scenes.context: 开场动作指令：把嘴抿上，如果法令纹消失了，可能是鼻基底凹陷。
sentences: 法令纹消失可能是鼻基底凹陷。
Folds gone? It may be a sunken nose base.
paraphrase: Folds gone? It may be a sunken nose base.
scenes.speak: Press your lips together. Folds gone? It may be a sunken nose base.

scenes.context: 第二组动作：眼睛睁大往上看，如果眉毛看起来飞起，可能是眼肌无力。
sentences: Open the eyes wide and look up.
眉毛飞起可能是眼肌无力。
Brows flying up may mean weak eye muscles.
paraphrase: Open the eyes wide and look up.
用weak eye muscles换一种说法
Brows flying up may mean weak eye muscles.
scenes.speak: Open the eyes wide and look up. Brows flying up may mean weak eye muscles.

scenes.context: 戴眼镜如果不太好看，说明山根塌，眼镜承托不住。
sentences: You don't look great in glasses.
It shows a low nasal bridge.
paraphrase: You don't look great in glasses.
It shows a low nasal bridge.
scenes.speak: You don't look great in glasses. It shows a low nasal bridge.

scenes.context: 近看比远看好看，属于扁平脸，立体度不足。
sentences: You look better up close than far away.
paraphrase: You look better up close than far away.
scenes.speak: You look better up close than far away. That means a flat face.

scenes.context: 侧脸比正脸好看，是面部比例有问题，正侧面对比最明显。
sentences: You look better in profile than head-on.
paraphrase: You look better in profile than head-on.
scenes.speak: You look better in profile than head-on. It's a facial-proportion issue.

practice: Press your lips together to test the folds.
Open the eyes wide and look up.
戴眼镜不好看说明山根塌。
Looking bad in glasses shows a low nasal bridge.
侧脸比正脸好看是比例问题。
Better in profile means a proportion issue.
pitfalls: 觉得自己丑就否定自己
先做几个自测动作找原因
很多「丑」是具体可修的面部特征
先测是不是鼻基底凹陷
戴眼镜不好看就换眼镜
山根问题换眼镜也难解决
对比正侧脸找比例问题
比例问题可通过角度缓解
shifts: 用自测动作找具体原因
